Name: Full Catalogue
Author: mitloaf
Description:
This is just a tiny mod to make the new wallpapers and floors accessible through the catalogue since by nature these items are not reusable and I noticed that it made some players (including me!) a little sad to realize that using and then preserving them would be difficult in case your roommate (cursed or otherwise) replaces them against your will!

I also noticed that, at present, not all of these are accessible through item spawners like CJB's, so this mod was birthed...This mod also includes the wallpaper and flooring you can get at the Casino since those require you to travel all the way to the desert to get :).

Manifest.Name: Full Catalogue
Manifest.Description: Adds missing wallpaper and flooring to the catalogue.
Manifest.Author: Mitloaf
